ruleDefinitions.name: Dynamic .NET Compilation Via Csc.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of "csc.exe" to compile .NET code. Attackers often leverage this to compile code on the fly and use it in other stages.

sequences.query: process_path = RGX("\\\\csc\\\.exe$") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Perflogs\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\Public\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\AppData\\\\Local\\\\Temp\\\\.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Temporary\\ Internet.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Windows\\\\Temp\\\\.*")) OR ((process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favorites\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Favourites\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Contacts\\\\.*")) OR (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\\\Users\\\\.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\Pictures\\\\.*"))) OR process_command_line = RGX("([Pp]rogram[Dd]ata|%([Ll]ocal)?[Aa]pp[Dd]ata%|\[Aa]pp[Dd]ata\([Ll]ocal([Ll]ow)?|[Rr]oaming))\[^\]{1,256}$")) AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\ \\(x86\\)\\\\") OR parent_process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Program\\ Files\\\\")) OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\sdiagnhost\.exe" OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\System32\\inetsrv\\w3wp\.exe") AND  NOT ((parent_process_path = "C\:\\ProgramData\\chocolatey\\choco\.exe" OR parent_process_path = "C\:\\ProgramData\\chocolatey\\tools\\shimgen\.exe") OR parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*\\\\ProgramData\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ Defender\\ Advanced\\ Threat\\ Protection.*") OR (parent_process_command_line = RGX(".*JwB7ACIAZgBhAGkAbABlAGQAIgA6AHQAcgB1AGUALAAiAG0AcwBnACIAOgAiAEEAbgBzAGkAYgBsAGUAIAByAGUAcQB1AGkAcgBlAHMAIABQAG8AdwBlAHIAUwBoAGUAbABsACAAdgAzAC4AMAAgAG8AcgAgAG4AZQB3AGUAcgAiAH0AJw.*") OR
